alex_fin: Heads up 8: detected an untagged GPU batch run that got billed to `internal-sandbox` for June. It's ~4.2k and should be split 50/50 Platform/Search per our standing agreement. Can Platform and Search approve a retro split?

hanna_ops: What's the ingestion timeframe? I can try a narrow reprocess window.

dmitri_platform: Created_at range: 2024-06-02T02:10:00Z -> 2024-06-02T05:45:00Z. Looks like a cron job launched ephemeral instances without the proper `team` label.

anya_search: Product accepts 50/50 as long as Finance confirms no external invoice impact.

alex_fin: External impact: none. All internal. Total to shift = $4,217.61. We've uploaded CSV: gs://billing-backfills/2024-06-untagged-batch.csv

hanna_ops: queued reprocess: `billing-tool reallocate --file gs://billing-backfills/2024-06-untagged-batch.csv --policy june-default --apply --note "50-50 internal split"`

billing-bot: Job #7432 queued. ETA 20m. Results to gs://billing-backfills/results/2024-06-realloc-7432.csv

dmitri_platform: Please include cost centers PLATFORM-CORE and SEARCH-TEAM in ledger rows. I'll review the ledger PR.

billing-bot: Job #7432 completed. Summary: 7 instances adjusted, total reallocated = $4,217.61. Output: gs://billing-backfills/results/2024-06-realloc-7432.csv

alex_fin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ledger/pull/321. Tagging hanna_ops and dmitri_platform for verification.

hanna_ops: Verified ledger diffs and test vectors. Approved.
